append.move_pose: When the target does not solve, reach_along_request also carries nearest_reachable_orientation: the smallest turn of the requested orientation (15 to 75 degrees in 15-degree steps, about axes perpendicular to the approach axis) that solves with the nominal jaw centre held, as a pose with approach_world and tilt_from_straight_down_deg, or none_within_sweep; endpoint IK only.
